capabilities: Embed password-manager secrets as placeholders in notes
Autocomplete and fuzzy-search secrets while typing {{
Resolve placeholders to live values at render time
Save a note selection as a new secret via right-click
Edit a secret's value through the backend without touching the note
extras: The README links detailed provider setup, security model and troubleshooting to separate documentation pages rather than including them inline; the store listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: LLM agents that manage the vault become unsafe once it holds credentials; the author wanted notes to stay readable while secrets live outside the vault, resolved at render time.
problem: Storing credentials in a vault exposes them to LLM agents, git history and backups, but keeping secrets only in a password manager leaves notes unreadable since the referenced values cannot be seen while reading or editing.

requires.name: a password manager backend (OpenBao/Vault, 1Password Connect, or Bitwarden/Vaultwarden server)

summary: Credential placeholder plugin that embeds password-manager secret references in notes and resolves them to live values inline, never writing secrets to the .md file.
